name: HVR
summary: HVR (Historical Volatility Ratio) is a custom indicator for MT5 that calculates the ratio of 6-period historical volatility to 100-period historical volatility, displayed in a separate window. It uses log returns of a selectable applied price and computes annualized standard deviation (assuming 52-week basis) for both short and long windows. The HTF version allows displaying this indicator on a higher timeframe while viewing a lower timeframe chart.
summary_zh: HVR（历史波动率比率）是一个MT5自定义指标，在独立窗口中计算6周期历史波动率与100周期历史波动率的比值。它使用可选应用价格的对数收益率，分别计算短期和长期窗口的年化标准差（假设52周基数）。HTF版本允许在低周期图表上显示高周期的指标数值。
strategy_analysis: HVR指标的核心概念是计算短期（6周期）与长期（100周期）历史波动率的比率，用于衡量市场波动性的相对变化。该指标首先对选定价格取对数收益率（ln(P_t/P_{t-1})），然后分别计算6周期和100周期窗口内的样本标准差，并乘以7.2111（即√52，用于年化周波动率）进行年化处理。最终指标值为hv6/hv100，当该比值大于1时表示短期波动率高于长期波动率，市场可能处于剧烈波动阶段；小于1时则相反。该指标本身不包含任何入场或出场条件，也不涉及仓位管理和资金管理，仅作为波动率分析工具使用。HTF版本通过iCustom调用基础HVR指标，实现多周期显示功能，方便交易者在低周期图表上观察高周期波动率比率变化。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the HVR indicator is to calculate the ratio of short-term (6-period) to long-term (100-period) historical volatility, measuring relative changes in market volatility. The indicator first computes log returns (ln(P_t/P_{t-1})) of a user-selected applied price, then calculates sample standard deviations over 6-period and 100-period windows respectively, multiplying by 7.2111 (which is √52, for annualizing weekly volatility) to produce annualized figures. The final indicator value is hv6/hv100; a ratio above 1 indicates short-term volatility exceeds long-term volatility, suggesting the market may be in an active phase, while below 1 suggests the opposite. The indicator itself contains no entry or exit conditions, nor any position sizing or money management logic — it serves purely as a volatility analysis tool. The HTF version calls the base HVR indicator via iCustom, enabling multi-timeframe display so traders can observe higher-timeframe volatility ratio changes on lower-timeframe charts.

parameters.description: HTF版本的指标垂直偏移量

pros: 波动率比率分析提供了市场波动状态变化的直观量化指标，有助于判断市场是处于平静还是活跃阶段
支持12种应用价格类型，包括自定义的Simpl、Quarter、TrendFollow和Demark价格，灵活性高
HTF版本实现多周期显示，方便交易者在不同时间框架下进行波动率分析
使用循环缓冲区（Count数组）优化数据管理，减少内存重分配开销
pros_en: The volatility ratio analysis provides an intuitive quantitative measure of market volatility regime changes, helping identify whether the market is in a calm or active phase
Supports 12 applied price types including custom Simpl, Quarter, TrendFollow, and Demark prices, offering high flexibility
The HTF version enables multi-timeframe display, convenient for volatility analysis across different timeframes
Uses a circular buffer (Count array) for efficient data management, reducing memory reallocation overhead
cons: 指标没有提供任何交易信号或阈值参考线，交易者需要自行判断波动率比率的含义和交易策略
6周期和100周期的窗口长度硬编码，无法通过参数调整，限制了策略适应性
年化因子7.2111（√52）假设周期为周线，在其他时间框架上使用会导致年化计算不准确
循环缓冲区索引逻辑（Recount_ArrayZeroPos）增加了代码复杂度且可读性差
cons_en: The indicator provides no trading signals or threshold reference lines; traders mustindependently interpret the volatility ratio and develop their own trading strategies
The 6-period and 100-period window lengths are hardcoded and not adjustable via parameters, limiting strategy adaptability
The annualization factor 7.2111 (√52) assumes weekly periods; using it on other timeframes produces inaccurate annualized volatility
The circular buffer indexing logic (Recount_ArrayZeroPos) adds code complexity and reduces readability
improvements: 将6和100的窗口长度改为可配置的input参数，并让年化因子根据当前图表周期自动计算，例如日线使用√252，小时线使用√(252*24)等
添加超买/超卖阈值水平线或信号线，帮助交易者更直观地识别波动率极端状态
用更清晰的循环缓冲区实现替代当前的Count数组索引方案，或直接使用MQL5的CopyBuffer系列函数简化数据访问
improvements_en: Make the 6 and 100 window lengths configurable input parameters, and auto-calculate the annualization factor based on the current chart timeframe (e.g., √252 for daily, √(252*24) for hourly)
Add overbought/oversold threshold horizontal lines or signal lines to help traders more intuitively identify extreme volatility states
Replace the current Count array indexing scheme with a cleaner circular buffer implementation, or use MQL5's CopyBuffer family of functions to simplify data access

risk_points: 该指标为纯分析工具，不执行任何交易操作，无交易风险
年化因子在不同时间框架上使用可能产生误导性数值
risk_points_en: This is a pure analysis tool that executes no trades, posing no trading risk
The annualization factor may produce misleading values when used on non-weekly timeframes

It uses log returns of a selectable applied price and computes annualized standard deviation (assuming 52-week basis) for both short and long windows. The HTF version allows displaying this indicator on a higher timeframe while viewing a lower timeframe chart.
